- Sean: please own coordination with account exec/AM to confirm any contract-level credits or SLA waivers we need to pre-authorize.

> Team —
>
> We’re seeing sustained error rates (502s) and increased p95 latency from Veridian’s production text-generation endpoint starting ~06:50 PT.

Got it — I’m on the bridge. Quick summary from infra:
- Root signal: tabulated as KV cache misses concentrated on shard-gamma; kernel-level throttle triggered on one GPU worker leading to cascading request retries.
- Temporary mitigation in progress: divert 30% of traffic to a compatible quantized variant (v2-q8) and enable aggressive prefix caching for repeat sessions.
- Observed effect so far: error rate dropping from 8.1% to ~3.6% after initial traffic split (10m). Latency p95 improved by ~120ms on diverted traffic.

ETA for full restoration (target p95 <300ms for all traffic): 45–75 minutes if current worker replacement and cache priming continue without regression. Will confirm if we need to trigger an automated fallback to our regional replica.

I’ll prepare a 2-line technical summary for Monica’s exec note.

—Marcus
Principal Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
